Trusted publishing cannot authenticate a package that does not exist yet. They were published once by hand and given a trusted publisher; the re-run of run 41053844815 then published all three from CI. articles.title: Arc: a ~70 MB streaming speech model that transcribes links names and metadata to your own list as they're spoken, with no second model [p]
articles.summary: I built Arc-Transcriber, which does ASR-NL in 1-step. Every 100 ms, one model returns the transcript plus: - Names linked to a list you give it (a roster, contacts, product names); new names are flagged "not on the list" - Numbers with their values (scores, clocks, money, dates) - Speakers and roles; - Sound and channel events (telephone audio, clipping, poor audio) - Whether the speech was addressed to an assistant. - Inbuilt tags for dialog act, speaker segmentation and more. Total 200+ trained decision heads. The usual ASR, then NER, then entity-linking and then LLM chain is collapsed...
